query: SELECT count(*), max(bbox.xmax-bbox.xmin), max(bbox.ymax-bbox.ymin), count(*) FILTER (WHERE bbox.xmax-bbox.xmin>=180) FROM read_parquet(?)
scope: Complete source-bbox scan, using the same already checksum-bound analytical file; the preceding full source comparison establishes the bbox/source relationship. This query did not independently recompute WKB envelopes or rehash the file.
